_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::particle_sph#0. The rule holds but the Signal is off by three orders of magnitude and points at the wrong mechanism. Switching Kernel1D -> Kernel2D on upstream particle_sph_1d_hydrostatic_freesurface_densityintegration_cubicspline_adami.4C.yaml is accepted in total silence (no warning matching kernel/dimension/mismatch anywhere) and does change the physics: three of five result tests fail, density moves 1.00015521027962739 -> 1.00020166835008029 and velx roughly doubles. But the density stays within 0.02% of INITDENSITY, not the claimed ~30%, so an agent screening for a 30% deviation clears a broken deck. The mechanism worth knowing is not normalisation: KERNEL_SPACE_DIM also fixes the particle volume, since 4C sets mass = INITDENSITY * INITIALPARTICLESPACING^KERNEL_SPACE_DIM. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: leave KERNEL_SPACE_DIM at the deck's own Kernel1D. The density and velocity return to the reference values, the deck passes and EXIT_KERNEL2D becomes 0, so the fixture must go red.
